title: Gather os.environ reads into BaseSettings
summary: Move scattered environment reads into pydantic-settings, then add an APP_ prefix after the fact.

files.content:
import os

DATABASE_URL = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]
REDIS_URL = os.environ.get("REDIS_URL", "redis://localhost:6379/0")
DEBUG = os.environ.get("DEBUG", "False") == "True"
MAX_UPLOAD_MB = int(os.environ.get("MAX_UPLOAD_MB", "10"))

turns.user: config.py reads os.environ directly and its a mess. DEBUG=true still gives False. redo it with pydantic-settings

assistant.body: Sure! Declare the settings as typed fields on a BaseSettings subclass and Pydantic takes over reading and converting the environment. Field names are not case sensitive, so database_url is read from DATABASE_URL, and a bool accepts true, 1, yes or on. This class is now the single source of truth for configuration. Wrapping get_settings in lru_cache means the .env file is read only once.

turns.user: oh wait prod has APP_ on everything. APP_DATABASE_URL etc

assistant.body: That is one setting in model_config, env_prefix. Note: the keys in the .env file need the prefix too.
